entities.name: Vadi
entities.description: Reclusive, fiery Vulshok shaman of the Oxidda Chain on Mirrodin who urged Elspeth back to action.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker knight despairing over Phyrexian corruption, whom Vadi rebuked.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: Vulshok who lives near Vadi and considers her mad.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: Companion of Elspeth on the Quest for Karn.

entities.name: Oxidda Chain
entities.description: Mountain range on Mirrodin where Vadi lives.

events.summary: Elspeth separates from Venser and Koth and returns to Vadi's cabin, where Vadi offers shelter and food.
events.quote: Vadi offered her shelter, food, and conversation.

events.summary: Vadi harshly rebukes Elspeth for her passivity and cowardice.
events.quote: She harshly rebuked Elspeth for her passivity

events.summary: Elspeth, renewed in resolve, leaves for Ish Sah.

relations.quote: Moved by the Vulshok shaman’s brutal candor
